---
title: "Supported devices"
---

Each driver captures the formats and conventions of a particular instrument or lab workflow.

| Driver | Instrument | Expected input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kt20` | KT20 magnetic susceptibility scanner | Scan CSV exports | Tidy measurement DataFrame |
| `pxrf` | Niton portable XRF | Excel exports; native `.ndt` via sidecar | Normalized elemental DataFrame |

See the [KT20 reference](kt20.qmd) and [pXRF reference](pxrf.qmd) for file expectations and output fields.
